// diagnostic E0080

Jet.ArrowFunctionBody

This named function body follows an arrow instead of braces.

What

This named function body follows an arrow instead of braces.

Why

A named function has one arrow, `->` or `-[Effects]>`, followed by its optional return type; the body always sits in braces: `name: fn(...) -> Type { … }`.

Fix

Replace `-> expr` with `{ expr }`; `jet fmt` applies this fix.

Worked example
